claim: For fixed \(p\in(0,1)\), \(a>0\), and \(m=\lfloor n^a\rfloor\), independent Bernoulli-\(p\) coloring of an \(m\times n\) row/column \(\mathsf{S5}\) frame has depth-one graded-modal type count \(K_1/F_a(n)\to1\) in probability, where with \(v=p(1-p)\) and \(L_v=\int_{\mathbb R}(1-e^{-e^{-x^2/(2v)}/\sqrt{2\pi v}})\,dx\), the five consecutive regimes \(0<a<1/2\), \(a=1/2\), \(1/2<a<2\), \(a=2\), \(a>2\) have normalization \(F_a(n)\) equal respectively to \(4\sqrt{2v(1-a/2)}n^{3a/2}\sqrt{\log n}\), \(4L_v\sqrt{3v/2}n^{3/4}\sqrt{\log n}\), \(16v\sqrt{(a-1/2)(1-a/2)}n^{(a+1)/2}\log n\), \(4L_v\sqrt{3v}n^{3/2}\sqrt{\log n}\), and \(4\sqrt{2v(a-1/2)}n^{3/2}\sqrt{\log n}\). Moreover \(K_1/(2RC)\to1\) in probability for \(R\) and \(C\) the observed numbers of distinct row and column sums; the depth-one definable Boolean algebra has exactly \(2^{K_1}\) elements.
